svg.text: Pascal ⇄ conflation lenses — each entry focuses its own prime-power towers
each entry C(r,c) → one lens conflating its towers p^vₚ(C(r,c)) as base-p space-filling curves (2 Hilbert · rest Peano)
within every lens the towers are screen-blended · spun at their own rate (interference) · pulsed to cohere ⇄ decohere; mirror entries share a signature (entryExps_symm)
exponent vₚ = number of base-p carries in c+(r−c) (Kummer); every tower p^vₚ divides C(r,c) (entry_ogg_dvd)
colours — 2 cyan · 3 magenta · 5 amber · 7 green · 11 orange · 13 violet · 17 teal · 19 red · 23 blue · 29 lime · 31 pink · 41 mint · 47 tan · 59 indigo · 71 white
